normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the private _transfer state updates.
The to parameter only exists to feed the private _transfer state updates.
The amount parameter is only consumed by _transfer fee and balance math.
The snapshot is immediately passed to swapTokensForEth.
The snapshot is immediately passed to sendETHToFee.
The amount is the direct input of the external swap call.
The path array is constructed solely for the external swap call.
The amount parameter is only used to split ETH inside sendETHToFee.
The array parameter only feeds the bots blacklist loop.
The parameter only feeds the single bots mapping write.
The account parameter is only used to index _rOwned.
The spender parameter is forwarded to _approve.
The recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
The sender parameter is the debited account of transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is the credited account of transferFrom.
The amount parameter drives both the transfer and the allowance subtraction.
The rate value is computed and consumed only inside tokenFromReflection.
The rAmount parameter is only the guarded division input.
The rate value is only produced by _getRate.
The supply variable is only produced and checked inside _getCurrentSupply.
The parameter is only consumed by the _getValues computation chain.
The balance variable is only used to call swapTokensForEth from manualswap.
The balance variable is only used to call sendETHToFee from manualsend.
The owner parameter is only used for the storage write and zero-address check.
The amount parameter is only written into the allowance mapping.
